investigation_notes.Description: An unusually large volume of SharePoint file downloads (3,450) was observed for the user Tiina.Koppel@globalcorp.ee, far above the 24-hour baseline of 12. The activity used a Python-based user agent indicating automated tooling, and the destination IP appears external, which raises concern for potential data exfiltration. The sample set includes sensitive documents such as patents and internal roadmaps, and the combination of high volume, external destination, and sensitive data makes this a high-priority incident requiring investigation.
